source.game: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
source.method: PPSSPP frame dump (1 video frame per emulated vblank, FFV1) + tools/framedata/video_metrics.py (motion + blade-trail pixel metrics) + per-frame contact-sheet review. 2 runs, 2026-10-15. See context/artifacts/2026-10-15/phase2-blades-framedata-FINAL.md
source.frame_zero: first frame of visible animation change (input latency NOT included: the dump has no input marker)
source.active_definition: VISUAL PROXY: frames where the blade trail is visibly extended / sweeping. Real hitbox frames are not measured yet (needs a target).
source.damage_method: enemy HP read live from the soldiers' health components (same component type as Kratos' HP; located by signature scan; offsets in gitignored research/). Undead soldier max HP = 20.

moves.description: forward chain thrust (both blades thrown straight ahead)
moves.notes: startup 11 (combat stance) / 12 (neutral) / 16 (includes turning to face the target). Active 12-16. Isolated tap returns to combat stance at +30. | damage: 2 per target; the thrust can hit 2 soldiers at once (3 samples)
chained-only move; start->next start 16 (run1) / 9 (mash) | damage: 1 sample
run2 wind-up longer (10f) - the square_2 -> square_3 boundary is ambiguous under mash | damage: 1 sample

moves.description: big overhead arc (ends the string when no further input)
moves.notes: largest trail of the first four hits; natural SwordWeapon3 (finisher) candidate | damage: multi-hit arc, 2 per tick, 2-4 ticks per target (~18 total over 3 soldiers in one sample)

moves.description: extended string seen only under continuous mashing: horizontal spin, sweep, rising vertical spin, diagonal overhead, wide horizontal circle, ground-slam finisher
moves.notes: run2 only (single sample). Whole 10-swing chain: first anim 264 -> settled 459 = 195 frames (~3.25 s). Trail-start interval mean for square_1..10 ~17 frames

moves.description: heavy: blades raised, double overhead slam, then a low follow-through hit
moves.notes: highly reproducible (both samples within 1 frame). Mashing Triangle does NOT chain a second heavy. SwordParry/Special candidate | damage: rising blades 2 (first ~18 f) + main slam 6; low follow-up missed (target knocked back). 2 runs identical

moves.description: dive + roll + stand up (Hades Rush slot candidate)
moves.notes: total 36-50 f depending on how 'settled' is judged; i-frames not measured (needs an incoming attack). Square right after the roll did not produce a distinct dash-attack

hades_time_note: Hades durations are in seconds; conversion applied in Phase 4 via Config.lua
